own_solution.law: Radiative exchange between infinite parallel grey diffuse surfaces in series: q = sigma (T_i^4 - T_j^4)/(2/eps - 1) per gap; with equal emissivity every gap has the same resistance so T^4 is evenly spaced
assumptions: infinite parallel opaque diffuse grey surfaces
same emissivity on every surface (both sides of each shield)
steady state, radiation only, thin shields

defect_reasons.other: T7BAD 'A heater is then warming the hot plate by a further 70 K' uses a progressive tense that sits awkwardly with the steady state, though the intended reading (hot plate held at 870 K) is clear enough.

notes: Th^4 = 4.096e11, Tc^4 = 8.1e9 K^4; T1^4 = Th^4 - (Th^4 - Tc^4)/3 = 2.75767e11 K^4, T1 = 724.66 K. Emissivity cancels because all three gaps have identical resistance 2/eps - 1. With hot plate at 870 K: Th^4 = 5.72898e11, T1^4 = 3.84632e11, T1 = 787.52 K. Number-bearing variants all state 70 K; 'few kelvin' sentences are numeral-free versions; emissivity variants both state 0.6.
